import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 205;
    static final int M = N * N;
    static int[] head = new int[2 * N];
    static int[] nxt = new int[M];
    static int[] to = new int[M];
    static int[] cap = new int[M];
    static int ec;

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int uv, int vu) {
        nxt[ec] = head[u];
        to[ec] = v;
        cap[ec] = uv;
        head[u] = ec++;
        nxt[ec] = head[v];
        to[ec] = u;
        cap[ec] = vu;
        head[v] = ec++;
    }

    static int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
        int flow = 0;
        while (true) {
            int[] dist = new int[2 * N];
            Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
            int[] parent = new int[2 * N];
            int[] pedge = new int[2 * N];
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            dist[s] = 0;
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (int e = head[v]; e != -1; e = nxt[e]) {
                    if (cap[e] > 0 && dist[to[e]] == -1) {
                        dist[to[e]] = dist[v] + 1;
                        parent[to[e]] = v;
                        pedge[to[e]] = e;
                        q.add(to[e]);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (dist[t] == -1) break;
            int f = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = parent[v]) {
                int e = pedge[v];
                f = Math.min(f, cap[e]);
            }
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = parent[v]) {
                int e = pedge[v];
                cap[e] -= f;
                cap[e ^ 1] += f;
            }
            flow += f;
        }
        return flow;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int dt = sc.nextInt();
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        int[][] a = new int[N][N];
        int[][] b = new int[N][N];
        boolean[][] red = new boolean[N][N];
        boolean[][] block = new boolean[N][N];
        for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int y = 0; y < n; ++y) {
                char c = line.charAt(y);
                if (c == 'Y') block[x][y] = true;
                else if (c == 'Z') red[x][y] = true;
                else a[x][y] = c - '0';
            }
        }
        for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int y = 0; y < n; ++y) {
                char c = line.charAt(y);
                if (c != 'Y' && c != 'Z') b[x][y] = c - '0';
            }
        }
        int m = n * n;
        int[][] dis = new int[m][m];
        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(dis[i], 1000000000);
            dis[i][i] = 0;
        }
        int[] dx = {0, -1, 0, 1};
        int[] dy = {1, 0, -1, 0};
        for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x) {
            for (int y = 0; y < n; ++y) {
                if (block[x][y] || red[x][y]) continue;
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                    int i = x + dx[d], j = y + dy[d];
                    if (i >= 0 && i < n && j >= 0 && j < n && !block[i][j] && !red[i][j]) {
                        dis[x * n + y][i * n + j] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int k = 0; k < m; ++k)
            for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i)
                for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j)
                    if (dis[i][k] + dis[k][j] < dis[i][j])
                        dis[i][j] = dis[i][k] + dis[k][j];
        int[] dred = new int[m];
        Arrays.fill(dred, 1000000000);
        int[] qx = new int[m];
        int[] qy = new int[m];
        int h = 0, t = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                if (red[i][j]) {
                    qx[t] = i;
                    qy[t] = j;
                    t++;
                    dred[i * n + j] = 0;
                }
        while (h != t) {
            int x = qx[h];
            int y = qy[h];
            h++;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int i = x + dx[d], j = y + dy[d];
                int id = i * n + j;
                if (i >= 0 && i < n && j >= 0 && j < n && !block[i][j] && !red[i][j] && dred[id] > 1000000000) {
                    dred[id] = dred[x * n + y] + 1;
                    qx[t] = i;
                    qy[t] = j;
                    t++;
                }
            }
        }
        int source = N - 2, sink = N - 1;
        boolean[] seen = new boolean[m];
        for (int cur = 0; cur < m; ++cur) {
            int sx = cur / n, sy = cur % n;
            if (block[sx][sy] || red[sx][sy]) continue;
            Arrays.fill(seen, false);
            h = 0;
            t = 0;
            qx[t] = sx;
            qy[t] = sy;
            t++;
            seen[cur] = true;
            while (h != t) {
                int x = qx[h];
                int y = qy[h];
                h++;
                int id = x * n + y;
                if (dis[cur][id] <= dt)
                    addEdge(cur << 1, (id << 1) | 1, 1000, 0);
                if (dis[cur][id] == dred[id]) continue;
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                    int i = x + dx[d], j = y + dy[d];
                    int nid = i * n + j;
                    if (i >= 0 && i < n && j >= 0 && j < n && !block[i][j] && !red[i][j] && dis[cur][nid] <= dred[nid] && dis[cur][nid] <= dt && dis[cur][nid] > dis[cur][id] && !seen[nid]) {
                        seen[nid] = true;
                        qx[t] = i;
                        qy[t] = j;
                        t++;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                addEdge(source, (i * n + j) << 1, a[i][j], 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                addEdge((i * n + j) << 1 | 1, sink, b[i][j], 0);
        System.out.println(maxFlow(source, sink));
    }
}
